displayName: OCI-LAT-CHN-007: Lateral movement chain — Pass-the-Hash → SMB → Domain Admin
description:
Detects pass-the-hash attack followed by SMB lateral movement to gain domain admin privileges

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: lateral movement chain — pass-the-hash → smb → dom

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_lat_chn_007", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%lateral%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%movement%') AND "value" > 0
